nominal.name: Nominal: 12 m/s carving, light wind (v3)
nominal.expect: Redesign filming steadily: no ≥1 px tether/boom artefact over the subject; KE ≤14.9 J; body force and endurance within the harmonised criteria.

nominal_v1.name: Nominal (v1 original design)
nominal_v1.expect: v1 baseline: 200 g, 100 V, pack-dome exit — re-scored with the harmonised criteria.

nominal_v2.name: Nominal (v2 design)
nominal_v2.expect: v2 comparison: 120 g, 56 V, 0.8 m hip-boom exit and dock.

short.name: Short turns (calibrated preset, 1.04 s/turn)
short.expect: Fast edge changes: tether sweep, tension jerks, clearance to poles/skis.

fast.name: High speed 18 m/s
fast.expect: Envelope stress: can the light drone keep up, and does KE exceed 14.9 J?

gust.name: Gusty crosswind 6 m/s + 7 m/s gust
gust.expect: Gust authority of the 120 g airframe: position error, tilt saturation, usable footage.

side.name: Side view (azimuth −60°, 5.5 m)
side.expect: Side view on the side opposite the exit: does the line still stay off the silhouette?

side_left.name: Side view (azimuth +60°, left side)
side_left.expect: Side view on the exit side: tether/boom expected over the subject — reported as a geometric limit.

fall.name: Rider fall (sudden stop from 12 m/s)
fall.expect: Reel protect mode; the drone brakes and does not strike the rider; closest approach and KE.

events.en: Fall detected (pack IMU decel > 6 m/s²): reel → protect/free-spool, drone brakes and climbs
Beyond this the rider’s tumbling/lying pose is not modelled (body still upright-crouched); tether–body clearance not credible

snag.name: Tree snag: drone-end cutter + autonomous landing (v2)
snag.expect: Snag → drone-end cut → free end slides off, reel retracts; the drone backs off and lands. Report body force and what is left on the obstacle.

leftOnObstacle.value: nothing (line retracted; drone landed near the obstacle for pick-up)

events.en: Tether caught on a branch 2.6 m above the snow (node 7)
Drone-end cutter fires: the drone backs away and lands on its backup cell
Free end slides off the branch: the line follows the rider and the reel retracts
Drone down on the snow (impact 0.6 m/s)

snag_wl.name: Tree snag: weak link only (comparison)
snag_wl.expect: Comparison: outcome for line and drone with only the weak link.

leftOnObstacle.value: the tether (~12 m) hanging in the tree, still tied to the drone

events.en: Tether caught on a branch 2.6 m above the snow (node 7)
Drone on backup cell: controlled descent to land

power.name: Tether power interruption (15 s backup)
power.expect: Descend on the small backup cell while following; the rider stops and the drone lands. Fail: energy runs out first.

events.en: Tether power lost: drone on its backup cell (~30 s), rider alerted to stop; descend while following
Drone down on the snow (impact 0.5 m/s)

dock.name: Launch & land on the hip boom while stopped (3 m/s gusty)
dock.expect: Launch/land from the 0.8 m hip boom: rotor guard ≥0.8 m from the helmet, distance to the glove, alignment and time.

Docked and latched (horizontal error 5.1 cm)
